correctness.rationale: All 196 finite simplices are regenerated from arc conditions. The embedded 96-pair acyclic matching, 4 critical cells, integral two-cocycle and primitive cycle pairing, and zero Alexander-Whitney cup square on all 12 four-simplices are reconstructed by standalone Python verifier. Forman gives one 0-, one 2- and two 4-cells. Since pi_3(S^2)=Z and its Hopf invariant is the integral cup square, both four-cell attachments are null. No finite experiment is extrapolated.

value.rationale: The exact homotopy type, not just ordinary homology, of the six-vertex bidirected polygon is an explicitly motivated missing case of a 2026 open wedge-homotopy question. Its potentially nontrivial two integral Hopf attachments cannot be settled by Betti numbers. The computation gives a mathematically meaningful Hopf-obstruction answer with an independently reproducible finite certificate, while refraining from extrapolating to an infinite family.
